name: question-bank
title: Readiness question bank (data/questions/<hazard>.csv)
description: One row per questionnaire item. Changing a hazard's questionnaire means editing this file, not code.

fields.name: QuestionKey
fields.description: ODK question name; join key with submissions.

fields.name: CategoryCode
fields.description: Pillar code. Must match a pillars[].code in data/config/hazards.json.

fields.name: Weight
fields.description: Weight used in the overall score (CategoryWeight from the ODK workbook).
